About Mingle & Speak

Language learning that fits real life.

Mingle & Speak is a modern language academy for professionals, students and exam candidates. Lessons are tailored around each learner’s goals, with an emphasis on practical communication, confidence and measurable progress.

Founder · English

Migle Simkute

Migle specialises in workplace English and goal-focused professional training. With more than six years of teaching experience, she also coaches TOEIC candidates through structured preparation designed to build both exam technique and confidence.

Co-founder · English & Spanish

Dearbhaile Mccusker

Dearbhaile teaches English and Spanish for professional, academic and personal goals. Her work includes IELTS and TOEFL preparation, Business and General English, conversational Spanish and exam-focused support.
